title: Pageboy Cap
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Pageboy Cap |image = Pageboy Cap.png |achievement = Well-Read |ad = Read every [[Books|book]]. |price = {{Price|5000}} }} The '''Pageboy Cap''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|5000}} after earning the "Well-Read" [[Achievements|achievement]] (read every [[Books|book]]). It can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. There is a ≈2% chance to receive the gender-neutral outfit with the Pageboy Cap. ==Notes== * The Pageboy Cap outfit also includes the [[File:Shirt017.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Mayoral Suspenders]] and [[File:Farmer Pants.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Farmer Pants]] (dyed RGB value 112,38,22). ==References== Male players have 47 possible outfits (1/47 ≈ 2.13%), while female players have 48 possible ones (1/48 ≈ 2.08%). See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb.
